scene_prompt:
A quiet pet shop interior late at night in a flat vintage rubberhose cartoon style. Soft warm yellow light from hanging lamps glows against the dark blue night outside the front windows. Keep the composition extremely simple and easy to read with only 5 main focal groups: the washing sink counter, a pet supply shelf, a stack of dishes, a cozy pet bed corner, and a tiny baby dinosaur toy made to look alive.

At the sink: soapy bubbles overflow slightly from a metal basin filled with freshly washed pet bowls and colorful dishes. A striped dish towel hangs over the counter edge beside a dripping sponge. Nearby sits a half-open bottle of soap and a small bucket with water on the floor. A pair of wet rubber gloves has been left beside the sink, strongly suggesting someone was washing dishes moments ago.

Funny unexpected detail: a tiny green baby dinosaur toy with shiny button eyes is standing upright near the bubbles pretending to roar at the soap foam like it is alive. Another playful detail: one bubble has landed perfectly on the dinosaur toy’s nose.

Include around 10 clear visible details total. Use colorful objects with memorable placements and environmental storytelling strongly suggesting late-night cleanup inside the pet shop after feeding animals. Warm cozy retro palette with deep blue nighttime tones outside, soft glowing interior lighting, clean readable silhouettes, simple shapes, minimal clutter, no text labels, no logos, no UI.
